newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Brent to test support at contract lows.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Brent to test support at contract lows.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+Brent crude is likely to test lower on Friday with the most
important support level at $17.48.
+Gas oil faces a strong band of resistance at $164 a tonne
and this will prove tough to break through.
IPE Brent crude oil futures are expected to test lower on Friday and the most important support level is at $17.48 a barrel, the contract's lowest point, which was reached a week ago.
August Brent closed 37 cents a barrel weaker on Thursday at $17.85, while July gas oil was $1.50 a tonne up at $161.75.
"The momentum indicators and the moving averages make me think the market is heading downwards and this would indicate a test of lower support," said Darren Gurner at Sucden in London.
He saw an initial support level at $17.61 a barrel and then at $17.48.
Beneath these levels he saw more supportive numbers at $17.43 and $17.31. These are important lows formed on the spot continuation chart.
He saw good resistance at $18.17 a barrel. This is Tuesday's high and also corresponds to the 20 day Moving Average.
Gurner saw gas oil also heading lower despite the fact that momentum indicators are pointing upwards, because of strong resistance lying in wait at $164 - a tonne.

"The current upwards move is a corrective bounce from earlier oversold levels and I think resistance is a bit too strong for the market to make a concerted attempt to break through it, given the weakness in the other markets."
The $164-$164.50 level is the high point reached on June 13, 16 and 17. "This is a strong band of resistance.
Al Graham at Elliott Wave in Gainsville, Georgia, said he would cautiously predict a downwards move.

"It now looks, tentatively, like $18.45 (the recent high formed on Wednesday) ended a corrective rally from $17.49 and that we're heading back down below that low. Confidence won't be strong in this view until $17.70 support gives way.
